answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Every identity must lock 1,000 USDC in the registry contract as the deposit inlet before any vote/grade call; each graded action emits a plume of signed receipts to the slashing oracle. A farm of 1000 clones pays 1,000,000 USDC and loses it all when the audit traces the shared plume and one narrow canyon in the identity graph. Honesty stays cheaper.
